name: Clarksburg (United States)
description: Light blue field with a white saltire for the two intersecting state highways, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing a red star for the city, with CLARKSBURG above and WEST VIRGINIA below in white.
history: Clarksburg is a city in Harrison County, West Virginia, and its county seat. The flag was adopted in 1923 (according to Flags of the World citing Robert F. Stealey's history of Clarksburg, making it one of the oldest city flags in the United States; the star stands for the five former towns that make up the city).

features.role: saltire for the intersecting state highways
